lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: you've been up to a lot lately, haven't you?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Are you feeling okay?
I'm a little hungover.
I'm as healthy as a horse.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Oh dear, sounds like you had a little too much to drink.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You should know that excessive drinking is harmful to your health.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: However, what I'm asking doesn't necessarily pertain to hangovers.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Is that really true?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Then why do you look so unhealthy to me?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Be honest with me.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You haven't been sleeping well lately, am I right?
How did you know?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Rapi consulted me about it.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: She's worried that you haven't been getting enough sleep lately.
Really?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I understand that you've got a lot on your plate,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: but you're overworking yourself.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: If you keep leading this kind of lifestyle,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: it'll wreak havoc on your sleep schedule.
I'll try to be more mindful.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: You really should.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: I know that your work weighs heavy on your mind,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: and that old habits die hard,

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: so I'll send you some special supplements for sleep.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Be sure to take them.
Thank you, Mary.
